text:
Account and Privacy — Verifying your identity
Before discussing or changing an order, support confirms the order ID and the email address on
the order. We never share order details, addresses or payment information with anyone other
than the account holder, even if they say they are a family member.

Account and Privacy — Password reset
Reset your password from the sign-in page with "Forgot password". The reset link expires after
30 minutes. Support staff cannot see or set passwords.

Account and Privacy — Deleting your data
You can ask us to delete your account and personal data. Deletion is completed within 30 days.
Order records needed for tax purposes are kept for 7 years, as the law requires.

Contacting a Human Agent — When the assistant hands over to a human
The support assistant passes the conversation to a human agent for: refunds above $500, refunds
outside the return window, warranty claims, injuries or safety incidents involving a product,
legal complaints, and any customer who asks to speak to a person.

Contacting a Human Agent — What happens after a handover
The assistant creates a support ticket with a short summary, so the customer does not have to
repeat themselves. A human agent replies by email within 1 business day; safety incidents are
answered within 4 hours.

Contacting a Human Agent — Support hours
Human agents work Monday to Friday, 8 am to 8 pm, and Saturday, 9 am to 5 pm (US Eastern time).
The assistant is available at any time.

Trailpoints Loyalty Program — Earning points
Members earn 1 Trailpoint for every $1 spent. Sale and clearance items earn half points.
Gift card purchases do not earn points.

Trailpoints Loyalty Program — Redeeming points
Every 500 Trailpoints can be redeemed for $10 off a future order. Points can be combined with
sale prices but not with other discount codes.

Trailpoints Loyalty Program — Points expiry
Trailpoints expire 12 months after they are earned. Returning an item removes the points that
were earned on it.

Orders — Order statuses
"Processing" means the order is being packed and can still be changed. "Shipped" means it has
left the warehouse and has a tracking number. "Delivered" means the carrier confirmed delivery.
"Cancelled" means the order was stopped before shipping and has been refunded.

Orders — Changing or cancelling an order
An order can be changed or cancelled within 1 hour of being placed, while its status is
"Processing". After that, wait for delivery and start a return instead.

Orders — Changing the delivery address
The delivery address can be changed only before the order ships. Once an order is "Shipped",
the address cannot be changed by us; the customer can contact the carrier using the tracking
link.

Orders — Order confirmation
An order confirmation email is sent within 15 minutes of purchase. Check the spam folder if it
does not arrive. The order ID starts with "PC-" followed by five digits.

Product Care — Tents
Dry a tent completely before storing it, to prevent mildew. Clean it with cold water and a soft
sponge; never machine-wash a tent or use detergent, which strips the waterproof coating.

Product Care — Waterproof jackets
Wash waterproof jackets with a technical cleaner on a cool cycle, then tumble dry on low heat
for 20 minutes to restore the water-repellent finish. Re-proof the jacket once a season.

Product Care — Sleeping bags
Store sleeping bags loose in a large cotton sack, never compressed in the stuff sack. Down bags
can be machine-washed on a gentle cycle with down wash, then tumble-dried on low with two clean
tennis balls to break up clumps.

Refunds — When refunds are issued
A refund is issued once the returned item reaches our warehouse and passes inspection, usually
within 3 business days of arrival. Orders that were never shipped are refunded as soon as they
are cancelled.

Refunds — How long a refund takes
Refunds go back to the original payment method. Card refunds appear within 5 to 7 business days
after we issue them; PayPal refunds appear within 2 business days. Store credit is available
immediately.

Refunds — Shipping costs
Original shipping charges are not refunded, unless the item arrived damaged, defective, or was
the wrong item. Return shipping is free with the prepaid label.

Refunds — Refunds the assistant can issue
The support assistant can issue a refund only after confirming the order ID and the email
address on the order. It can refund up to $500 per order. Refunds above $500, and refunds
outside the return window, must be handled by a human support agent.

Returns Policy — Return window
Most items can be returned within 30 days of the delivery date. The item must be unused, clean,
and in its original packaging with all tags attached. The 30 days are counted from the day the
carrier marks the order as delivered, not from the order date.

Returns Policy — Sale and clearance items
Items bought on sale or from the clearance section can be returned within 14 days of delivery.
After 14 days, sale items are final sale and cannot be returned or refunded. Sale items that
arrive damaged or defective are covered by the warranty instead (see the warranty policy).

Returns Policy — Items that cannot be returned
Gift cards, personalised or engraved items, opened fuel canisters, and worn underwear or socks
cannot be returned for hygiene and safety reasons. These items are marked "non-returnable" on
the product page.

Returns Policy — How to start a return
Start a return from the Orders page of your account, or ask the support assistant with your
order ID and the email address used on the order. You will receive a prepaid return label by
email within one business day. Drop the parcel at any partner carrier location.

Shipping — Shipping options
Standard shipping takes 3 to 5 business days and is free on orders over $75; below $75 it
costs $6.95. Express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days and costs $15. Orders placed before
2 pm on a business day ship the same day.

Shipping — International shipping
We ship to Canada, the United Kingdom and the European Union. International orders take 7 to 14
business days. Import duties and taxes are paid by the customer on delivery.

Shipping — Tracking an order
A tracking link is emailed when the order ships. Tracking can take up to 24 hours to show the
first scan.

Shipping — Lost or missing packages
If tracking shows no movement for 10 business days, or a package marked delivered cannot be
found, contact support. We open a carrier claim and send a replacement or a refund once the
claim is confirmed, usually within 5 business days.

Warranty — Standard warranty
Tents, backpacks and sleeping bags carry a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects,
counted from the delivery date. The warranty covers broken zips, seam failures and faulty
buckles. It does not cover wear and tear, accidents, or damage from misuse.

Warranty — Lifetime warranty
Pinecrest-brand trekking poles carry a lifetime warranty. If a pole section breaks during normal
use, we replace that section free of charge, for as long as the original buyer owns the poles.

Warranty — Making a warranty claim
To make a claim, contact support with the order ID and photos that show the defect. We reply
within 2 business days with a repair, a replacement, or store credit. Warranty claims are
handled by a human support agent.
